intuition: Track keys by frequency, with recency order inside each frequency, so both eviction rules are available directly.

brute_force.approach: Scan every cached key to find the smallest frequency and oldest key before evicting.

optimal.approach: Map keys to values and frequencies, and map each frequency to an ordered collection of its keys; keep the smallest active frequency.

edge_cases: A zero-capacity cache stores no entries.
Updating an existing key also raises its frequency and recency.
